title: Statement Terms of Personal Credit Cards: Minimum Payment, Due Date and Smallest Interest Charge
content:
Each statement of a Piedmont Crescent Bank card under Personal Credit Cards carries a minimum payment, a payment due date counted in calendar days from the closing date, and, where interest is due, a smallest billable interest charge. The tier also fixes how many courtesy reversals of residual interest a customer may receive in a rolling 365 days.

| Tier | Percentage of the new statement balance | Minimum payment floor | Calendar days from closing to due date | Smallest interest charge | Residual interest courtesy reversals per 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 1.0 percent | 25.00 USD | 25 | 1.00 USD | 1 |
| College Rewards Visa | 1.0 percent | 25.00 USD | 25 | 0.50 USD | 1 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 1.0 percent | 35.00 USD | 25 | 1.00 USD | 1 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 1.0 percent | 35.00 USD | 25 | 1.00 USD | 1 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 1.0 percent | 35.00 USD | 25 | 1.00 USD | 1 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 1.0 percent | 35.00 USD | 25 | 0.00 USD | 2 |

The percentage of the new statement balance and the 25 calendar days to the due date are the same on all six tiers. The floor separates the two entry tiers, at 25.00 USD, from the other four, at 35.00 USD. College Rewards Visa carries the lowest smallest interest charge of the tiers that have one, 0.50 USD, and Visa Infinite Private Client has none at all, its figure being 0.00 USD; it is also the one tier allowing 2 courtesy reversals of residual interest in a rolling 365 days rather than 1.
